scenarios.title: A creature with horsemanship can be blocked only by creatures with horsemanship

setup.notes: Shu Cavalry is a 2/2 with horsemanship, Hill Giant a 3/3 with no abilities, Wu Light Cavalry a 1/2 with horsemanship, Grizzly Bears a 2/2 with no abilities.

decisions: A attacks player B with Shu Cavalry and Hill Giant.
B declares Grizzly Bears blocking Shu Cavalry and Wu Light Cavalry not blocking.

variants.label: plain_blocks_horsemanship
variants.expected: The block is illegal (Grizzly Bears has no horsemanship): Grizzly Bears is not a legal blocker for Shu Cavalry.

variants.label: horsemanship_blocks_horsemanship
variants.delta: B declares Wu Light Cavalry blocking Shu Cavalry instead (Grizzly Bears does not block).
variants.expected: The block is legal: Wu Light Cavalry has horsemanship and blocks Shu Cavalry.

variants.label: horsemanship_blocks_plain
variants.delta: B declares Wu Light Cavalry blocking Hill Giant instead (Grizzly Bears does not block).
variants.expected: The block is legal: a creature with horsemanship can block a creature without it.

variants.label: plain_blocks_plain
variants.delta: B declares Grizzly Bears blocking Hill Giant instead (Wu Light Cavalry does not block).
variants.expected: The block is legal: neither creature involved has horsemanship.

scenarios.title: A second instance of horsemanship does not change the blocking restriction

setup.notes: Shu Cavalry already has horsemanship; Riding Red Hare gives it a second instance until end of turn.

decisions: A casts Riding Red Hare targeting Shu Cavalry, tapping all three Plains; both players pass and the spell resolves.
A attacks player B with Shu Cavalry (now 5/5).
B declares Grizzly Bears blocking Shu Cavalry; Wu Light Cavalry does not block.

variants.label: plain_blocker
variants.expected: The block is illegal: with two instances of horsemanship Shu Cavalry is still blockable only by creatures with horsemanship, and Grizzly Bears has none.

variants.label: horsemanship_blocker
variants.delta: B declares Wu Light Cavalry blocking Shu Cavalry instead (Grizzly Bears does not block).
variants.expected: The block is legal: Wu Light Cavalry has horsemanship.

scenarios.forge_notes: Riding Red Hare is a sorcery cast in main1; the setup step is main1 and combat follows within the same decisions.
